title: Bank Impersonation & OTP Theft
description: Caller poses as Chase fraud department alerting to unauthorized charges, creating panic, and demanding a 6-digit SMS code.

steps.text: Hello, this is officer Miller from the Chase Bank Fraud Prevention Department calling regarding suspicious activity on your account.
We detected an unauthorized charge of $1,849.00 originating from an IP address in Miami, Florida.
To secure your account and block this fraudulent transaction, you must act right now. Do not hang up the phone or your funds will be permanently locked.
I am generating a one-time security authorization passcode to your phone right now. Please read back the 6-digit passcode to verify your identity.
